item.title: SeleniumHQ/docker-selenium
item.author: emecas
item.description:
SeleniumHQ/docker-selenium
Provides a simple way to run Selenium Grid with Chrome, Firefox, and Edge using Container Platform, making it easier to perform browser automation at scale
Go repository by SeleniumHQ, created in 2014, with 8,662 stars and 2,535 forks. Starred on 2017-06-15.
Homepage: http://www.selenium.dev/docker-selenium/
https://github.com/SeleniumHQ/docker-selenium

Source: starred on GitHub on 2017-06-15: SeleniumHQ/docker-selenium.
